question:
In a certain code language,

"A + B' means 'A is the mother of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the brother of B'

'A x B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the father of B'

Based on the above, how is Q related to Tif '‘P x Q – R + S ÷ T'?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/153c6a6e313de03f2911e6352e768c319ce48bd8d9b10cf6c7d58c07f604979a.png]

Given Expression: P x Q - R + S + T

P x Q: P is the wife of Q.

Q – R: Q is the brother of R.

R + S: R is the mother of S.

S ÷ T: S is the father of T.

According to the given information Family Tree Representation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/38b5395e46eefd21f0e50179200b15f69066aeaf4aa569b8b8f22da2a6b0ab94.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0c6341b3c38dc3f11b31120bbe40a4410a3f6916ba5fd40ca2cc8fce3da8dbf.png] 

Therefore, Q is the **Father's mother's brother** of T.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**
